reason: mask_secret('12345678', 0) returns '********12345678' because value[-keep_last:] with keep_last=0 is value[0:], the entire string. A masking function should never reveal the full secret, so the function needs a guard for keep_last <= 0 (for example, return all asterisks) and a test covering it. Negative keep_last has the same problem. The existing tests do not cover this path.
